skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Develop research skills including literature review, data collection, and analysis.
Improve ability to write clear, concise, and well-structured reports and papers.
Enhance critical thinking abilities to analyze and solve real-world problems.
Learn project management techniques to manage time, resources, and deliverables effectively.
Gain expertise in analyzing real estate markets, policies, and trends.
Understand legal frameworks related to real estate, business operations, and financial regulations.
Develop effective presentation skills for defending the thesis before a committee.
